summary: Export-status endpoint now works with personal API tokens that have forms-read, and returns 404 unless the export job belongs to the requested form (closing a cross-form leak of export status/download URL); API docs corrected.

statements.why: Route stays in auth.multi with authorize('view',$form); change tightens security.

statements.text: The open form submissions export statu part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /open/forms/[form]/submissions/export/status/[jobId]

statements.why: Example job_id changed to a UUID.

misses.what: Security fix not mentioned: a logged-in user with access to any form could poll another form's export job (progress and download link) by using its job id under their own form; now 404.
Personal API tokens can now check export status, only with forms-read permission; others get 403.
API docs pointed to a wrong URL for export status and listed wrong fields; now fixed with a changelog entry.
